title: Not on mainnet yet
body: The contract is not deployed on mainnet yet, so nothing on this site holds real money today. Every number shown comes from a test chain until launch.

title: Program deploys at launch
body: The contract goes on mainnet at launch. Until then there is nothing to bid on and no SOL is held. Every listing, bid and payout after that is a public transaction, linked on the Every transaction page.

title: Safer signing and clearer prices
body: Before you sign, the site now reads the listing straight from the chain and refuses if it differs from the page. Buy buttons show the exact price, commas are no longer read as decimal points, and coin pictures load through our server so token creators never see who visits.

title: Trust pieces on the site
body: Added the Check it yourself strip, a public list of every transaction with Solscan links, this change log, and a banner that shows on every page while a contract upgrade is proposed.

title: Site on real data
body: The site now reads every listing, bid and sale from the chain and the server, and every action is a real transaction signed only by your wallet. Tested end to end on a local validator with three people bidding, buying and settling.

title: Reward payout fixes
body: Hourly reward payouts: every sale counts once, payout retries are bounded, a fee claim is measured from what actually arrived, and payouts can be switched off on their own.

title: Hourly seller rewards
body: Each hour the creator fees are claimed, 10% goes to the team and 90% goes to the top 3 sellers of the hour, split 50, 30 and 20. Every claim and payout is a public transaction.

title: Contract fixes
body: Fixes across the contract, each covered by a test.

title: The contract
body: The auction contract: live auctions with late bid extensions, fixed price listings, listings made by posting on X, one per X account drops, refunds anyone can trigger, and credits for accounts that cannot be paid directly.
